notes.title: Grimfield Mystery nominated for the Game Connection America Awards, please vote
notes.content:
Hey! We are so happy to share that [b]Grimfield Mystery[/b] has been nominated for the [b]Game Connection America Awards[/b]!

Because of that, we are asking for your support by [b]voting[/b] for it to be eligible to win the [b]Player's Choice Award![/b] 

It takes 1 click 👉 [url=https://forms.gle/pZ3Lx3dHo5bxNm5v5]https://forms.gle/pZ3Lx3dHo5bxNm5v5[/url]

Thanks in advance! ❤️
